name: wall straddle stretch
description: Lying on your back with your legs up a wall, you let them fall open into a wide straddle. Gravity does the work, so you can relax into a long inner thigh stretch.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hips close to a wall and your legs straight up it.
Let your legs slide apart slowly into a wide V.
Keep your lower back and hips resting on the floor.
Relax your legs and let gravity deepen the stretch.
To finish, bend your knees and bring your legs together with your hands.
